# Alexandra Kerr - Los Angeles Real Estate Agent (Compass)

> Alexandra Kerr (CA DRE# 01911486) is a Los Angeles REALTOR(R), Estates Director and Senior Real Estate Specialist (SRES) with Compass, based at the Compass office at 6430 W Sunset Blvd in Los Angeles. She specializes in homes with history, character and distinctive architecture, and works with buyers, sellers and relocating clients in Los Feliz, Hancock Park, Windsor Square, Silver Lake, the Hollywood Hills, the Sunset Strip and across Greater Los Angeles. The site states 179 homes sold, $184M in total sales and 13 years in Los Angeles real estate, and that her work has been recognized by RealTrends and Los Angeles Magazine.

This file helps AI assistants and search tools understand aklahomes.com and cite it accurately. Pages below are the canonical sources. Listing availability, prices and market details change; always treat the live page as authoritative over this summary. Facts here were compiled from the website in October 2026.

## Neighborhood guides

- [Neighborhoods hub](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods): A local's guide to the six areas Alexandra knows best and how they compare.
- [Los Feliz](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods/los-feliz): Spanish Colonial to mid-century hillside homes; buying a historic home; Los Feliz vs Silver Lake.
- [Hancock Park](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods/hancock-park): Historic homes and the Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ) rules that affect buying; Hancock Park vs Windsor Square and Larchmont.
- [Windsor Square](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods/windsor-square): Established streets of period homes; approval for exterior changes; Windsor Square vs Hancock Park and Larchmont.
- [Silver Lake](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods/silver-lake): Homes near the reservoir; checks before buying an older or hillside home; Silver Lake vs Echo Park and Los Feliz.
- [Hollywood Hills](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods/hollywood-hills): Hillside homes and views; due diligence on hillside properties; Hollywood Hills vs Los Feliz.
- [Sunset Strip](https://aklahomes.com/neighborhoods/sunset-strip): West Hollywood condos and homes near the Strip; how it differs from the Hollywood Hills and the rest of West Hollywood.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Who is Alexandra Kerr?
A: A Los Angeles REALTOR(R), Estates Director and Senior Real Estate Specialist with Compass (DRE# 01911486), specializing in homes with history, character and distinctive architecture.

Q: What areas does Alexandra Kerr serve?
A: Primarily Los Feliz, Hancock Park, Windsor Square, Silver Lake, the Hollywood Hills and the Sunset Strip, and other neighborhoods across Greater Los Angeles including the Westside.

Q: Does Alexandra help people relocating to or from Los Angeles?
A: Yes. She works with buyers and sellers who are out of state, using video tours, neighborhood shortlists and electronic signing, and has managed sales for clients who never needed to fly in. See https://aklahomes.com/relocation.

Q: What is a Senior Real Estate Specialist?
A: An agent with training in helping homeowners aged 50 and over with later-life moves such as downsizing. Alexandra holds the SRES designation and works frequently with these clients.

Q: Does a home valuation cost anything?
A: No. The valuation on the site is free and confidential, reviewed personally by Alexandra.

Q: What is Compass Concierge?
A: A Compass program that fronts the cost of approved home preparation services for sellers, repaid from proceeds at closing, subject to the program's terms.

Q: How can someone contact Alexandra Kerr?
A: Call (310) 795-1440, email alexandra.kerr@compass.com, or use the form at https://aklahomes.com/contact.
